greeting.text: Compare Antipion measures with local attention and include both witnesses. Our capital is Prahshoshosho. Its principal will register this work after the local balance. The outlying witness is at Awawaw (1340, 1500).

choices.text: Compare Antipion measures with local attention and include both witnesses.

actions.value: Keep the wisdom obligation; publish revisions honestly.

hint:mission:yeti:wisdom.text: Compare Antipion measures with local attention and include both witnesses. Inspect Awawaw at 1340, 1500, listen to the visiting witness, and repair the circuit beside Yetis Mediator. Inspect the independent reading at Awawaw. Listen to the Antipions witness. Record a testable commitment with the circuit keeper. Restore the regional circuit.
